fact: Casablanca Internet Exchange Point (CAS-IX) in Casablanca has 3 members listed in PeeringDB and 30 Gbps aggregate capacity, per Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker (data as of May 2026).

FEZIX in Fez has 3 Moroccan members (Corebach Backbone, HOSTOWEB, PIXI MEDIA), 2 of 3 peering at the route server, and 210 Gbps aggregate capacity, per Internet Society Pulse's IXP Tracker (PeeringDB data, January 2026).
